title: JeffersonWM under-construction and 404 routing pass
content:
JeffersonWM now has a cleaner shared safety layer for unfinished and missing pages.

What changed:

  • Under construction: added a shared JeffersonWM-hosted under-construction page that can show the target site name from a query parameter, matching the current banner/auth/copyright shell.
  • Paused apps: root routing now sends paused public paths such as Bullion, Clionidae, Millionfold, and Vermilion to the shared under-construction page instead of leaving each one to fail differently.
  • 404 handling: added a simple shared 404 page with top-left 404, top-right Sign In, bottom-right copyright, directory browsing disabled, and Apache ErrorDocument 404 /404.html.
  • App route guards: Aphelion, Battalion, Billionaire, Lionship, and Stallioneer now route unknown app paths toward the shared 404 baseline while preserving their normal valid app paths.
  • Design cleanup: tested a randomized garbled-text image treatment for 404s, then intentionally returned the page to a quieter blank main window with only the shared background.

This gives the platform a more consistent public edge: unfinished sites explain themselves, bad URLs land somewhere calm, and future app routing work has a shared page to point at.
